purpose: Teach: 新聞紙/ナルニア/極上/旅立ち/母音/アイデンティティー/灯台/ピンク色

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、新聞紙の山を整理してリサイクルに出しましょう
lines.en: Sho, let's get that pile of newspapers sorted and ready for recycling.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact and practical. Light, forward momentum. The tone of someone who's organizing a weekend task. Not unkind, just efficient—eyes on the next thing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ナルニア物語の続きが読みたいよ
lines.en: But Mom, I really want to keep reading Narnia.
lines.style: Gentle push-back, not defiance. A small voice with real conviction underneath. Slight hopeful lilt at the end—testing whether this might change the plan.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが極上のステーキを焼いて下さったわ
lines.en: Well, your father made us some beautiful steak.
lines.style: Warm redirect. A small smile in the voice. Matter-of-fact about the generosity—not overselling it, just presenting it as fact. Inviting him to pivot.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、メイ姉さんの旅立ちが嬉しいやら寂しいやら
lines.en: Mom, I'm happy about Mei leaving, but... it's sad too.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful. Speaking something that matters. The hesitation before 'it's sad' is genuine—he's working out the feeling as he says it. No rush. Vulnerable.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが英語の母音発音を教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Your father taught you the English vowel sounds, didn't he?
lines.style: Noticing, gentle. A mother's quiet observation of something her son might not realize she sees. Warm, reflective tone—acknowledging a moment of learning that passed between them.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、家族のアイデンティティーを大事にしたい
lines.en: I want to really take care of what our family means.
lines.style: Sincere, thoughtful. Speaking something tender that costs him a little to say out loud. Steady. Not performative—just honest. Slight vulnerability underneath the clarity.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと灯台のある半島へ行きましょうね
lines.en: We'll go out to that cape with the lighthouse, you and your father and me.
lines.style: Soft, gentle promise. A mother planning something small and meaningful. Warm but grounded—not sentimental, just warm. The certainty of someone who knows this matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんがピンク色のお花を植えて下さったよ
lines.en: Grandma planted those pink flowers, you know.
lines.style: Warm, conversational. A small moment of lightness and continuation. The voice of someone noticing her son's attention, sharing in his noticing. Gentle, almost smiling.
